-- public.vw_client source
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_client AS SELECT mc.id, rev.enum_value AS state, to_char(mc.activation_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS creationdate, to_char(mc.updated_on::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS lastmodifieddate, to_char(mc.activation_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS approveddate, mc.firstname, mc.lastname, mc.mobile_no AS mobilephone, NULL::text AS preferredlanguage, CASE WHEN gender_cv.code_value::text = 'Hombre'::text THEN 'MALE'::character varying WHEN gender_cv.code_value::text = 'Mujer'::text THEN 'FEMALE'::character varying ELSE gender_cv.code_value END AS gender, client_type_cv.code_value AS clientrolekey, NULL::text AS loancycle, NULL::text AS grouploancycle, ccp."Direccion" AS addresses_0_line1, 0 AS addresses_0_indexinlist, mc.id AS iddocuments_0_clientkey, CASE WHEN id_type_cv.code_value::text = 'Cédula de ciudadania'::text THEN 'CC'::text ELSE upper(id_type_cv.code_value::text) END AS iddocuments_0_documenttype, ccp."Cedula" AS iddocuments_0_documentid, 0 AS iddocuments_0_indexinlist, mc.external_id AS informacion_adicional_external_id, mc.email_address AS emailaddress, mc.activation_date AS activationdate, NULL::text AS notes, NULL::text AS addresses_0_line2, ciudad_cv.code_score AS divopola_code_ciudad, ciudad_cv.code_value AS addresses_0_city, departamento_cv.code_value AS addresses_0_region, departamento_cv.code_score AS divopola_code_departamento, NULL::text AS addresses_0_postcode, 'COLOMBIA'::text AS addresses_0_country, NULL::text AS iddocuments_0_issuingauthority, NULL::text AS middlename, to_char(mc.date_of_birth::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS birthdate, ccp."Telefono domicilio" AS homephone, NULL::text AS profilepicturekey, NULL::text AS assignedbranchkey, NULL::text AS closeddate, ccp."Numero Celular Secundario" AS mobilephone2, NULL::text AS verificacion_cliente_telefono_celular, NULL::text AS verificacion_cliente_direccion, NULL::text AS verificacion_cliente_fecha_verificacion, now() AS last_value, mc.last_modified_on_utc AS update_date, mc.id AS encodedkey_id, ccp."Numero Celular Secundario" AS detalles_clientes_numero_celular_secundario, ccp."Edad" FROM m_client mc LEFT JOIN campos_cliente_persona ccp ON mc.id = ccp.client_id LEFT JOIN r_enum_value rev ON rev.enum_name::text = 'status_enum'::text AND rev.enum_id = mc.status_enum LEFT JOIN m_code_value gender_cv ON gender_cv.id = mc.gender_cv_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value client_type_cv ON client_type_cv.id = mc.client_type_cv_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value id_type_cv ON id_type_cv.id = ccp."Customer Identifier_cd_Tipo identificacion" LEFT JOIN m_code_value ciudad_cv ON ciudad_cv.id = ccp."Ciudad_cd_Ciudad" LEFT JOIN m_code_value departamento_cv ON ciudad_cv.parent_id = departamento_cv.id;
